supplements.title: Astragaloside IV targets TUBB4B to inhibit proliferation and promote apoptosis of pituitary tumor cells via the STMN1/ERK pathway.
supplements.summary: Astragaloside IV, a compound from traditional Chinese medicine, stops pituitary tumor growth by targeting a protein called TUBB4B.

supplements.title: Combining bioinformatics prediction with experimental validation to explore the ameliorative effect of Psoralea corylifolia on vitiligo.
supplements.summary: Psoralea corylifolia plant extracts increase melanin production in vitiligo through multiple active ingredients targeting apoptosis and PI3K/Akt pathways.

supplements.title: Inhibiting FGFR by toadflax reverses erlotinib resistance in nonsmall cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: Bufalin reverses erlotinib resistance in lung cancer by blocking FGFR, restoring drug effectiveness when combined with erlotinib.

supplements.title: Anti-hepatocellular carcinoma activity of Jacaranda mimosifolia through experimental validation and network pharmacology.
supplements.summary: Jacaranda mimosifolia extract inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma cell growth and triggers cancer cell death through multiple molecular pathways.

supplements.title: Study on material basis and network mechanism of the Guizhi Fuling pills in the treatment of endometriosis and endometrial polyps.
supplements.summary: Guizhi Fuling pills treat endometriosis and endometrial polyps through compounds like luteolin and quercetin, targeting inflammation and estrogen pathways.

supplements.title: Weighing the risk: a scoping review on the relationship between obesity and glioma.
supplements.summary: Obesity's link to glioma risk varies by age, gender, and body composition, with early-life weight and lifestyle factors playing significant roles.

supplements.title: The orexinergic system mediates the effects of ginsenoside Rg1 against cyclophosphamide-induced reproductive toxicity.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rg1 protects male mice from chemotherapy-induced infertility by activating a specific cellular receptor in the testes.

supplements.title: Chemical constituents and anti-ulcer effects of a wild pear (Pyrus syriaca Boiss.): Phytochemical, histopathological and apoptotic approaches.
supplements.summary: Wild pear extract protects against gastric ulcers by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death in rats.

supplements.title: Chitosan-mediated nano-bioprocessing of Acacia seyal seed extract for enhanced antineoplastic, anti-Helicobacter pylori and antioxidant performance.
supplements.summary: Acacia seyal extract wrapped in chitosan nanoparticles effectively kills colorectal cancer cells and fights H. pylori bacteria.

supplements.title: Aromatic amino acid metabolism shapes autophagy-mediated adaptation to iron deprivation in glioblastoma cells.
supplements.summary: Iron deprivation triggers protective autophagy in glioblastoma, which can be blocked by supplementing aromatic amino acids to enhance cell death.

supplements.title: Repurposing rosmarinic acid as an anti-colorectal cancer agent through bolstering T cell anti-tumor immunity by enhancing activation of MEK1-mediated TCR signaling.
supplements.summary: Rosmarinic acid, a natural compound, strengthens immune T cells against colorectal cancer by enhancing their signaling pathways and tumor-fighting ability.

supplements.title: S-equol promotes ferroptosis in triple negative breast cancer by coordinating NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy and PPARγ-mediated lipid metabolism.
supplements.summary: S-equol kills triple negative breast cancer cells by triggering ferroptosis through iron accumulation and lipid damage pathways.

supplements.title: RETRACTION: Dieckol Inhibits Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Cell Proliferation and Migration by Regulating the PI3K/AKT Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: This article on dieckol's effects on lung cancer has been retracted due to duplicated images from other sources without authorization.

supplements.title: Mobile Health Technology Ownership and Use Among Cancer Survivors in a Health System.
supplements.summary: Cancer survivors with mobile health devices could increase physical activity, but doctors need to understand how willing patients are to share this data.

supplements.title: Complete tumor regression with exclusive Ayurvedic treatment in adenocarcinoma of prostate: a case report.
supplements.summary: A prostate cancer patient achieved complete tumor disappearance using only Ayurvedic herbal medicines in this single case report.

off_label.title: Systemic glucocorticoid use and risk of site-specific cancers: a methodological systematic review of observational studies.
off_label.summary: Observational studies on glucocorticoids and cancer risk have significant methodological flaws, with inconsistent findings except for possible non-Hodgkin lymphoma associations.

off_label.title: Aging-dependent microglial heterogeneity worsens outcomes in models of traumatic brain injury.
off_label.summary: Aged brains develop harmful immune cells after traumatic injury, but blocking a protein called ELF1 or using an existing drug restores protective immunity and improves recovery.

off_label.title: Metformin drives HIF-1α-mediated dual metabolic reprogramming to enhance γδ T cell therapy in triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Metformin enhances immune T cell therapy for triple-negative breast cancer by boosting immune cell energy and strengthening tumor recognition.

off_label.title: MIG-6 Regulates HDAC1-Mediated Angiogenesis and Tumorigenesis in PTEN-Deficient Endometrioid Endometrial Cancer.
off_label.summary: MIG-6 suppresses endometrial cancer growth by blocking HDAC1, offering a potential new treatment target for this common gynecologic cancer.

off_label.title: Medium-Chain Fatty Acid Receptor GPR84 Modulates Cytotoxic CD8 T-cell Antitumor Immunity through Metabolic Reprogramming.
off_label.summary: Blocking GPR84 receptor boosts CD8 immune cells' ability to fight tumors by increasing their energy and cytotoxic function.

off_label.title: Symptom management with osilodrostat in multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 with a Cushing syndrome presentation.
off_label.summary: Osilodrostat effectively managed Cushing syndrome symptoms in a MEN1 patient, reducing cortisol levels and enabling significant weight loss when surgery wasn't feasible.

off_label.title: Medulloblastoma response to mevalonate pathway inhibition is independent of p53 status.
off_label.summary: Medulloblastoma cells respond to mevalonate pathway inhibition regardless of whether they have mutated or normal p53 genes.

off_label.title: LDHA-driven lactate metabolism promotes MDSC activation and immunosuppressive microenvironment in prostate cancer.
off_label.summary: LDHA-driven lactate metabolism in prostate cancer activates immune-suppressing cells; blocking LDHA enhances immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Filgotinib inhibits METTL3-mediated m6A of EIF3A by targeting ERG-TBP to suppress PDAC progression JAK-STAT3-independently.
off_label.summary: Filgotinib, a rheumatism drug, suppresses pancreatic cancer growth by reducing a cancer-promoting protein modification independently of its known JAK-STAT3 pathway.

off_label.title: Evaluating Intermittent Dosing of Aspirin for Colorectal Cancer Chemoprevention
off_label.summary: A trial testing whether intermittent aspirin doses can prevent colorectal cancer in patients with adenoma.

off_label.title: A Target Validation and Efficacy Study of Metformin in Patients With Recurrent or Progressive Posterior Fossa Group A (PFA) Ependymoma
off_label.summary: Researchers are testing metformin to treat children and young adults with recurrent or progressive posterior fossa ependymoma brain tumors.

off_label.title: Functional profiling of somatostatin receptors identifies somatostatin receptor subtype 2 as a vulnerability in Succinate Dehydrogenase SDHB-deficient pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas.
off_label.summary: A selective somatostatin receptor 2 drug effectively kills SDHB-deficient pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma cancer cells in laboratory studies.

off_label.title: Artificial Intelligence-Guided Optimization of Hyaluronic Acid-Coated Liposomal Linagliptin for Targeted Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome.
off_label.summary: AI-optimized liposomal linagliptin with hyaluronic acid coating improved PCOS treatment by enhancing drug delivery and reducing oxidative stress in rats.

off_label.title: Survival assessment of warfarin and international normalized ratio exposure in cancer-associated venous thromboembolism: Veterans Affairs healthcare system-based analysis.
off_label.summary: Cancer patients on warfarin for blood clots showed 16% lower death risk than those on other anticoagulants.

off_label.title: Protease-Activated Receptor-2 Promotes Metastasis: An Emerging Therapeutic Target.
off_label.summary: PAR-2 protein promotes cancer metastasis and blocking it with existing drugs may improve treatment outcomes for advanced cancers.

biomarkers.title: Sialic acid cis-ligand dynamics modulate Siglec-7 and -9 function and affect Siglec-7/9 co-blockade to potentiate natural killer cell anti-tumor activity.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking both Siglec-7 and Siglec-9 together enhances natural killer cells' ability to kill melanoma and leukemia cells more effectively than blocking either alone.

biomarkers.title: Astragaloside IV targets TUBB4B to inhibit proliferation and promote apoptosis of pituitary tumor cells via the STMN1/ERK pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Astragaloside IV, a compound from traditional Chinese medicine, stops pituitary tumor growth by targeting a protein called TUBB4B.

biomarkers.title: Mechanism of and research progress on alterations in the RET gene in thyroid cancer (Review).
biomarkers.summary: RET gene mutations and fusions drive the development of medullary and papillary thyroid cancers, making it a key treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Combining bioinformatics prediction with experimental validation to explore the ameliorative effect of Psoralea corylifolia on vitiligo.
biomarkers.summary: Psoralea corylifolia plant extracts increase melanin production in vitiligo through multiple active ingredients targeting apoptosis and PI3K/Akt pathways.

biomarkers.title: Emerging roles of POLR2L of RNA polymerase II dynamics and disease mechanisms (Review).
biomarkers.summary: POLR2L protein dysfunction drives cancer growth and drug resistance by disrupting RNA polymerase function and key cellular signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Hematopoietic progenitor kinase 1 inhibitor BGB-15025 induces apoptosis in acute myeloid leukemia cells through the cell cycle pathway and mitogen-activated protein kinase/extracellular signal-regulated kinase pathway signaling axis.
biomarkers.summary: BGB-15025, a new drug, kills acute myeloid leukemia cells by blocking cell cycle progression and disrupting cancer-promoting signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Inhibiting FGFR by toadflax reverses erlotinib resistance in nonsmall cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Bufalin reverses erlotinib resistance in lung cancer by blocking FGFR, restoring drug effectiveness when combined with erlotinib.

biomarkers.title: Role of histone modifications in gastric cancer (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Histone modifications, especially lactylation, regulate gene expression and drive gastric cancer development, progression, and immune evasion through metabolic changes.

biomarkers.title: Advances in the mechanisms of extracellular vesicles and circulating tumor cells in hepatocellular carcinoma metastasis (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Extracellular vesicles and circulating tumor cells work together to promote hepatocellular carcinoma metastasis by preparing target organs for cancer spread.

biomarkers.title: VSNL1 attenuates hypoxia‑induced myocardial apoptosis by regulating the CNP/NPRB pathway.
biomarkers.summary: VSNL1 protein reduces heart cell death from low oxygen by activating a protective signaling pathway, offering potential treatment for heart disease.

biomarkers.title: Diagnostic importance of serum markers in lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Blood-based serum markers show promise for earlier lung cancer detection through non-invasive liquid biopsy analysis.

biomarkers.title: Coassembled Prodrug Nanoparticles Mitigating the Acquired Resistance to Protein Degradation Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining cancer-fighting PROTACs with rapamycin to overcome drug resistance in breast cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: Posttranscriptional reprogramming controls MASLD progression through chronic ER stress adaptation.
biomarkers.summary: High-fat diet triggers protein-level changes in liver cells that drive hepatocellular carcinoma progression through stress adaptation mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Regulation of mitochondrial ROS by C15ORF48 in a basal cell subpopulation contributes to chemotherapy resistance in TNBC.
biomarkers.summary: A protein called C15ORF48 in triple negative breast cancer cells reduces chemotherapy damage by lowering reactive oxygen species, enabling drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: Claudins interact with LILRB immune inhibitory receptors to promote myeloid immunosuppression in cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer cells use claudin proteins to interact with immune cells, suppressing immunity and promoting tumor growth, but blocking this interaction reverses these effects.

trials.title: Hematopoietic progenitor kinase 1 inhibitor BGB-15025 induces apoptosis in acute myeloid leukemia cells through the cell cycle pathway and mitogen-activated protein kinase/extracellular signal-regulated kinase pathway signaling axis.
trials.summary: BGB-15025, a new drug, kills acute myeloid leukemia cells by blocking cell cycle progression and disrupting cancer-promoting signaling pathways.

trials.title: Coassembled Prodrug Nanoparticles Mitigating the Acquired Resistance to Protein Degradation Therapy.
trials.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining cancer-fighting PROTACs with rapamycin to overcome drug resistance in breast cancer cells.

trials.title: Regulation of mitochondrial ROS by C15ORF48 in a basal cell subpopulation contributes to chemotherapy resistance in TNBC.
trials.summary: A protein called C15ORF48 in triple negative breast cancer cells reduces chemotherapy damage by lowering reactive oxygen species, enabling drug resistance.

trials.title: Anti-cancer effect of a novel photodynamic therapy using glucose-linked chlorin e6 conjugated trastuzumab for HER2-positive gastrointestinal cancers.
trials.summary: A new photodynamic therapy using antibody-linked light-activating molecules selectively targets and kills HER2-positive gastrointestinal cancer cells.

trials.title: Utilizing the transformer mechanism to predict cervical lymph node metastasis in patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma.
trials.summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence to predict which papillary thyroid cancer patients have spread to neck lymph nodes before surgery.

trials.title: Glucocorticoid Receptor Antagonist Approved for Ovarian Cancer.
trials.summary: A new drug called relacorilant improves survival in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer when combined with chemotherapy.

trials.title: PRognostic and predictive potential Of multiparametric dynamic whole-body 18F-FDG PET Imaging using a Long axial field-of-view (LAFOV) system for FIRST-line chemo-immunotherapy efficacy in advanced non-small cell lung cancer: PROFIL-1 study protocol.
trials.summary: Study tests whether advanced PET imaging can predict which lung cancer patients benefit from chemotherapy-immunotherapy combination treatment.

trials.title: In-House Advanced 3D Printing Enhances TMJ Surgical Planning: The 10-Year Evolution of the Mayo Clinic Experience.
trials.summary: 3D printing models improved surgical planning and outcomes for complex temporomandibular joint cases over ten years at Mayo Clinic.

trials.title: Post-marketing signal detection of fruquintinib-associated adverse events using the FAERS database.
trials.summary: Fruquintinib for colorectal cancer shows expected safety concerns including diarrhea, nausea, and bone marrow suppression in real-world use.

trials.title: Evaluation of adverse event profiles for leuprolide and goserelin: Insights from the FDA adverse event reporting system following STROBE guidelines.
trials.summary: Leuprolide and goserelin, used for hormone-dependent cancers, show distinct safety profiles, with leuprolide linked to reproductive and cancer-related side effects and goserelin to endocrine disorders.

trials.title: Correlation between quantitative DCE-MRI and pathologic complete response in patients with invasive ductal carcinoma undergoing neoadjuvant systemic therapy.
trials.summary: Pretreatment MRI measurements of tumor edges predict which breast cancer patients will achieve complete response to chemotherapy.

trials.title: HIF-1α siRNA Enhances the Efficacy of Erlotinib in Non-small Cell Lung Cancer: A Novel Strategy to Reverse Hypoxia-Induced Drug Resistance.
trials.summary: Blocking HIF-1α protein in lung cancer cells restores effectiveness of erlotinib, a drug that cancer cells often resist through low-oxygen conditions.

trials.title: Sequential Use of Trastuzumab Deruxtecan and Sacituzumab Govitecan in Patients with Breast Cancer: A Pharmacological Approach to Support the Clinical Rationale.
trials.summary: Two breast cancer drugs targeting different tumor proteins may be used sequentially to overcome drug resistance and improve treatment outcomes.

trials.title: FIGO 2023 staging system with/without molecular classification vs. FIGO 2009 in 172 endometrial cancer patients.
trials.summary: FIGO 2023 staging with molecular classification better predicts outcomes in endometrial cancer than the older 2009 system.

trials.title: Mass Spectrometry-Based Spatial Imaging of the Cochlea.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a technique to map molecules in the inner ear's hearing structure, revealing distinct cellular regions and their chemical signatures.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture improves cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms in breast cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture treatment improved cognitive function and mental health symptoms in breast cancer survivors in a pilot study.

mind_body.title: Supportive Care Interventions in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Supportive care interventions like exercise, music, and stress management show promise for improving quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: The Effect of Yoga and Relaxation Techniques on Anxiety, Stress Levels, and Quality of Life in Parents of Children Diagnosed with Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Yoga and relaxation techniques significantly improve anxiety, stress, and quality of life in parents caring for children with cancer.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Acupuncture for Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may help improve thinking and memory problems caused by cancer and its treatments, though more rigorous research is needed.

mind_body.title: Music therapy interventions on symptom management in adults with advanced cancer - multisession longitudinal impact: systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions may help reduce symptoms and improve quality of life in adults with advanced cancer receiving end-of-life care.

mind_body.title: Consensus Recommendations for Disease- and Treatment-Related Fatigue in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer: A Modified Delphi Panel.
mind_body.summary: Experts created guidelines to help doctors and advanced prostate cancer patients manage fatigue together through shared decision-making.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture Enhances Effectiveness of Omeprazole in Indomethacin-Induced Gastric Injury Mice via Nrf2 Activation and Vagus Nerve Conduction.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with omeprazole more effectively heals drug-induced stomach damage in mice than omeprazole alone.

mind_body.title: Application of Affective Touch in Patients With Advanced Cancer: Effects on Existential Distress, Pain, and Quality of Life.
mind_body.summary: Affective touch, a gentle hands-on therapy, reduced existential distress, pain, and improved quality of life in advanced cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Art Therapy for Oncology Nurses: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based art therapy reduces psychological stress in oncology nurses, improving their wellbeing and patient care quality.

mind_body.title: Acupoint catgut embedding ameliorates laparotomy-induced cognitive decline in aged mice by restoring gut microbiota.
mind_body.summary: Acupoint catgut embedding treatment reduced post-surgery cognitive decline in elderly mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effects of manual acupuncture on microglial polarization and the Sirt1/NF-κB pathway in a rat model of post-stroke depression.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may treat post-stroke depression by reducing brain inflammation through immune cell regulation.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Postoperative Analgesia After Perianal Abscess Surgery Using Ultrasound-Guided Pudendal Nerve Block Combined with Wrist-Ankle Acupuncture: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Ultrasound-guided nerve blocks combined with acupuncture effectively reduced pain after perianal abscess surgery compared to standard treatment alone.

mind_body.title: Developing and Evaluating an Inpatient Caregiver Support Program: Feasibility, Acceptability, and Perceived Impact.
mind_body.summary: A hospital program providing emotional support and guidance to family caregivers of seriously ill patients proved feasible, acceptable, and beneficial.

mind_body.title: Dual-Target SPG-Mandibular Neuromodulation for Post-Radiation Painful Trigeminal Neuropathy: A 7-Year Follow-up.
mind_body.summary: A 7-year study shows nerve stimulation effectively reduces chronic facial pain caused by radiation damage.

mind_body.title: Music in the Last Hours: Finding Humanity in the ICU.
mind_body.summary: Personalized music played at a cancer patient's bedside in the ICU reduced distress and provided comfort during final hours of life.
